a2_part.applied: Q140(l)'s part (predict_m9_a2.py burst()), called on M9's D600 per tile

band_rule_M8: power: half-width = k x sqrt(pool^2 + s^2 x C x), pool = M8's nested rms for the tile's format and card, C the jackknife covariance by kind, s the card scale; k = max(q95 of |nested residual| / pool over all M8 rows, the same over the rows of blind pools 3, 4 and 5 (E115, E140, E141, E142)); heat: M7's (k_h x pool_h); aifoundry2: the 95th percentiles of |measured - predicted| leave one kind out over E80's, E83's and E143's bursts (clock, board W), peak = B(800) + c s(800) + the q95 excess of the highest board sample over E143's traces, with c at D's band top
band_rule_M9: power: half-width = k x sqrt(pool^2 + s^2 x C x), pool = M9's nested rms for the tile's format and card, C the frozen form's jackknife covariance by kind, s the card scale; k = max(q95 of |nested residual| / pool over all M9 rows, the same over the rows of blind pools 3-6 (E115, E140, E141, E142, E153, E157)); heat: M7's (k_h x pool_h); aifoundry2: M8's frozen bands and peak rule, or Q140(l)'s with --a2-terms
